out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. OBSERVED GE FREEZERS, THE TOUCH ON EZ COOK RAMYUN COOKERS IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: GE FREEZER, THE TOUCH ON EZ RAMYUN COOKER. EHS INFORMED PIC THAT ANY ADDITIONAL EQUIPMENT IN KITCHEN THAT WAS NOT ORIGINALLY LISTED IN ORIGINAL PLANS MUST BE APPROVED BY HEALTH DEPARTMENT PRIOR TO PURCHASE/USE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HAND WASHING SINK AT SERVING COUNTER WITH SOILED CUPS IN BASIN. OBSERVED HAND WASHING SINK AT JUICE BAR BEING USED TO RINSE DRINKWARE.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEES TO HAVE ALL SOILED DRINKWARE WASH, RINSED, AND SANITIZED IN MAIN KITCHEN DISH MACHINE OR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEES TO ONLY USE HAND SINKS FOR HAND WASHING.

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The following food ITEM WAS observed to be unsound or adulterated: LARGE STICKS OF BUTTER IN 3 DR UR. BUTTER APPEARED TO HAVE GREEN MOLD-LIKE SUBSTANCE ON OUTSIDE PACKAGING AND INTO BUTTER STICK ITSELF.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: CUPS, BLENDER CONTAINERS RINSED AT HAND SINKS.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE HAVE CUPS AND BLENDER CONTAINERS WASH, RINSED, AND SANITIZED AT DISH MACHINE. KOKEERI (Inspection Date: 10/06/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED CAN OF RESIDENTIAL PEST SPRAY ON SHELF IN KITCHEN
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EMPLOYEE DISCARDED PEST SPRAY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: CEILING LIGHT ABOVE DISH AREA MISSING BULBS AND LIGHT COVER. CEILING LIGHT ABOVE BACK PREP SINK/WIC NEEDS NEW LIGHT BULB.
violations.corrective_action: REPLACE LIGHT BULBS AND LIGHT COVERS.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises. OBSERVED UNUSED KITCHEN EQUIPMENT STORED IN DRY STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions. REMOVE EQUIPMENT NO LONGER USED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BEAN SPROUTS AT 48F, SLICED CHEESE AT 48F, AND DUMPLING AT 48F IN COLD RAIL AT BOBA STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM WILL DISCARD FOODS AT 1:30 - 4 HOUR MARK. CFM WILL MONITOR TEMPERATURE OF FOODS IN UNIT AND WILL PLACE COVER ON UNIT AND/OR ADD ICE/WATER TO BOTTOM OF RAIL TO MAINTAIN PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURE OF 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present at beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM arrived during inspection. A CFM must be present during all hours of operation.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: kimchi.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM will datemark containers of kimchi.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: boba
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. Employee updated placard with date and time boba is in use.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squirt bottles of sauces and oils, secondary containers of spices near cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM agreed to label secondary containers with food names.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Hard Wood
violations.observation: Observed wood plank used to position baffle inside of ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Wood and wood wicker may not be used as a food-contact surface unless the wood is hard maple or close-grained and used for cutting boards, cutting blocks, bakers' tables, and utensils such as rolling pins, doughnut dowels, salad bowls, and chopsticks. CFM will removed wood plank and replace with acceptable item made of food-grade material.
